description: Get a client-ready report for a site: GEO score breakdown, and — if a Visibility Report share link (slug) is available — AI mention-rate results across engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok). Use this when the user asks for 'a report on this site', 'how is this client doing', or wants something to hand to a client. Pass `report_slug` if you have a causabi.com/report/<slug> link (full report, no API key needed). Pass only `domain` for a score-only summary (no monitoring history available without a Causabi login).

domain.description: Domain to report on (e.g. 'example.com'). Required if report_slug is not given.

report_slug.description: Visibility Report slug from a causabi.com/report/<slug> share link. When given, returns the full mention-rate report instead of just the score.

name: get_site_report
